Verified end-to-end with the real API via curl and compared screenshots at 1280px and 375px against the approved sketch.", "notes_for_reviewer": "Headless Chrome on this machine clamps the real layout viewport to a 500px-wide floor when --window-size is below 500, even though the output PNG is cropped to the requested size — I discovered and documented this (with the iframe-wrapper workaround used to get an accurate 375px screenshot) in docs/STATE.md for later tasks that need phone-width screenshots. Separately, I could not script into the app's iframe from a file:// wrapper to automate the error-message screenshot (cross-origin restriction), so that specific visual (red error text on invalid URL) was verified by reading the reused sketch logic plus a curl-confirmed API response rather than a screenshot — worth a quick manual look if you want to see it rendered." }
